# CLI reference

```text
isummicron render --image IMAGE [options]
```

`python -m summicron.render.convolve` accepts the same flags. Back to the [README](../README.md).

## Basic

### `--image PATH`

Required.
Input image (HEIC, JPEG or PNG). LiDAR depth needs an iPhone Portrait HEIC; for other images use `--depth-source monocular`.

### `--out-dir DIR`

Default: `unset`.
Output directory (default `./runs/render`). Writes `<stem>[_r<N>]_rendered[_ds<scale>].jpg` and `.png`.

### `--output PATH`

Default: `unset`.
Write exactly this file instead (`.png` writes PNG, anything else JPEG quality 95). Overrides `--out-dir`.

### `--depth-scale VALUE`

Default: `1.0`.
Multiplier on the depth map (meters) before focusing. The quick start uses 10.

### `--depth-source {lidar|monocular}`

Default: `lidar`. Choices: `lidar`, `monocular`.
`lidar`: the HEIC's embedded depth. `monocular`: Depth Anything V2 Small (needs the `depth` extra; downloads about 100 MB on first use).

### `--focus-xy X Y`

Default: `unset`.
Focus point, normalized: X = column, Y = row, (0, 0) = top-left, each in [0, 1]. Omitted: the closest subject.

### `--downres N`

Default: `unset`.
Downsample so the long edge is N pixels (never upscales). Adds `_r<N>` to output names. 2048 is the fast preview size.

### `--hdr-source {none|macos}`

Default: `none`. Choices: `none`, `macos`.
`none`: 8-bit SDR load. `macos`: load the HDR gain map with Core Image and tonemap back to SDR, so highlights keep headroom (macOS 15+, `hdr-macos` extra).

### `--occlusion-compositing {off|on}`

Default: `off`. Choices: `off`, `on`.
`on`: layered compositing that removes halos at depth edges, for about 1.4–1.6× render time. With `--psf-norm peak` it falls back to `off` with a warning.

## Highlights

### `--bright-pass-thresh VALUE`

Default: `1.0`.
Linear-luminance level above which pixels bloom as highlights. 1e9 disables.

### `--bright-pass-region-size N`

Default: `31`.
Highlight detector size in pixels (0–255; 0 turns the region gate off). Suggested 15 small lights, 31 default, 63 large lights.

### `--bright-pass-floor VALUE`

Default: `0.1`.
0–1. Bloom kept outside detected highlights (0 strict, 1 no gate). Used when region size > 0.

### `--bright-pass-norm-pct VALUE`

Default: `99.0`.
50–100. Detector percentile that sets the bloom scale. Used when region size > 0.

## Advanced

### `--tensor PATH`

Default: `unset`.
PSF tensor `.npz`. Default: the tensor shipped with the package.

### `--focus-target-m VALUE`

Default: `unset`.
Advanced. Tensor focus distance in meters (default: the tensor's own, 0.7 m for the shipped tensor). Other values warn that the subject may not be sharp.

### `--psf-norm {l1|peak}`

Default: `l1`. Choices: `l1`, `peak`.
`l1`: energy-preserving kernels. `peak`: peak-normalized kernels; highlights bloom more and can clip.

### `--slab-batch-size N`

Default: `unset`.
Depth slabs per batch (default 1). Larger values only use more memory; output is identical.

## Shadow match (experimental)

### `--shadow-match-mode {off|on}`

Default: `off`. Choices: `off`, `on`.
Experimental. `on` matches shadow colour to the SDR input before tonemapping. Needs `--hdr-source macos`.

### `--shadow-band-hi VALUE`

Default: `0.7`.
0–1. Upper luma bound of the matched band.

### `--shadow-match-max-gain VALUE`

Default: `4.0`.
1–16. Cap on the per-channel gain.

### `--shadow-match-strength VALUE`

Default: `1.0`.
0–4. Strength multiplier (1.0 = exact match).

## Environment variables

- `ISUMMICRON_MAX_BYTES`: Memory budget in bytes for the pre-render guard (default 12 GiB). A render estimated above it stops with a message that names a `--downres` that fits.
- `ISUMMICRON_DEBUG`: Set to any value other than empty or `0` to print the full traceback instead of the one-line `render: <msg>` error.

## Exit codes

- `0`: the render finished.
- `2`: an input or option error; one line `render: <message>` on stderr.
